title: Non-uniquely Extendible Maximal Globally Hyperbolic Spacetimes in Classical General Relativity: A Philosophical Survey
exact_version: In Hofer-Szabo, Wronski (eds.), Making it Formally Explicit, European Studies in Philosophy of Science 6, Springer 2017, ch. 11, pp. 193-212, DOI 10.1007/978-3-319-55486-0_11, author copy

assumptions: Vacuum focus (until Costa et al.); exact solutions with symmetries; spatially compact; Butterfield-style S-determinism with S = MGHD

limits: Philosophical survey; relies on her summaries for Chrusciel-Isenberg 1993, Costa et al. 2015, Ringstrom 2009
